verdict.rationale: ANEF is an online portal that stores personal data, so where that data is stored is a fair privacy question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains only two front-door probes: a JavaScript shell for the ANEF app and a Cloudflare challenge on the ministry site. Neither documents any user-selectable storage region or residency option, so with no evidence of the capability the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
